note: The weekly posting slots, taken from the quarter's rhythm in the brand file: Tuesday is the document, Wednesday is the video, Thursday is written that week from something that happened, and Instagram takes two a week. Monday prepares and Friday engages; neither posts. The times are a starting point. Change them here once a few weeks of numbers say otherwise.
rules: Nothing posts unless it was approved for a time. Approving is the sign-off.
One post per slot. A second post for the same slot goes to the next open one.
Reply to every LinkedIn comment inside the first two hours. Schedule for a time you can be there.
Event photos go out within a week of the event, while the people in them still remember it.
Every attempt, posted or failed, goes into the publish log with the exact text and an image fingerprint. Download it for the firm's records.
